id: title:Silthus:keep composer selection on release outside input

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application: preserves selection and editor focus when a user releases a drag-select or clicks outside the input, while still allowing buttons and menus to retain their own actions.
review.reason: Adds a shared utility and its tests, then replaces inline DOM-query-based background-click handling with calls to this utility in two message-editor and task-detail input components.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a shared utility and its replacement of inline DOM handling, which demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in behavior. However, the actual benefit and user experience improvement are not independently verified, and the tier is not assigned based on the number of PRs, lines, or paths.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.
